Name: Pierre Sells More
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
[list=1]
[*][b]﻿Shop Expansion:[/b] Your mod expands Pierre's shop inventory with new items, increasing the variety of products he has available for sale.

[*][b]Stock Adjustment:[/b] You've adjusted the stock of these items and their prices based on a few factors, such as friendship points (FP) with Pierre. For instance, when you have 2000 FP with Pierre, the prices of some items are halved (0.5x), making them cheaper for you to purchase.

[*][b]New Items:[/b] You've added various types of items to Pierre's shop. These items include:
[list]
[*]Fertilizers: Introduced different types of fertilizers, including basic, quality, and deluxe variants.
[*]Retaining Soil: Similar to fertilizers, I've included different types of retaining soil for farming.
[*]Speed-Gro: This is another farming item that helps crops grow faster.
[*]Tree Fertilizer: Specialized fertilizer for trees.
[*]Crops: Added various crops like Red Cabbage, Parsnip, Melon, Pumpkin, Corn, Apple, Apricot, Orange, Peach, Pomegranate, Cherry, Grape, Spice Berry, Sweet Pea, and more. These ﻿can be grown on your farm.
[*]Foraged Items: I've included forageable items like Common Mushroom, Wild Plum, Hazelnut, Blackberry, Winter Root, Crystal Fruit, Snow Yam, Crocus, Coconut, and Cactus Fruit.
[*]Special Items: There are also special items like Poppy and Fiddlehead Fern, which can have unique uses or be used in crafting.
[/list]
[*][b]Limited Availability:[/b] Some items, like the Stardrop, are available in limited quantities, adding an element of rarity to your mod.
﻿

[/list]

Manifest.Description: Adds new items for Pierre to sell.
